trigger: Arrive at Lou's radio shack, Proctor.

nodes.speaker: lou
nodes.text: Come in, come in. This is the warmest room in Proctor. Car battery and sin.

nodes.speaker: lou
nodes.text: You're Dell. Hank talks about you like a daughter he could yell at.

nodes.speaker: hank
nodes.text: Kid. Sit. You look like hell. Good. Means you're paying attention.

nodes.speaker: hank
nodes.text: Thomson. Unit 2. Nobody tagged it out when the grid went. Gates are shut. Machine's fine.

nodes.speaker: hank
nodes.text: Hydro can black-start. Open the headgates, bring up the exciter, sync to nothing.

nodes.speaker: hank
nodes.text: Twenty megawatts, give or take. Enough to heat a hospital. Or a fort.

choices.text: You sound like hell yourself, Hank.

nodes.speaker: hank
nodes.text: Because you did the drill. Because you don't talk. Because I trust you with a fort.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: He coughs into a rag. He folds it before you can see it.

nodes.speaker: hank
nodes.text: ...Lung. Doc said spring, before the lights went. Now? Don't count on spring.

nodes.speaker: hank
nodes.text: So I'd like to do one more thing right. Don't make it a whole thing.

nodes.speaker: hank
nodes.text: A protective relay kit. The plant's is fried. Authority's got one at the Proctor depot.

nodes.speaker: hank
nodes.text: Or I fake it with jumper and prayer. Slower. Might kill me first.

nodes.speaker: lou
nodes.text: Everyone will want it, you know. The minute a light shows up on that hill.

nodes.speaker: lou
nodes.text: I tell people the ships are coming. Someone has to give them a reason to wait.

nodes.speaker: lou
nodes.text: ...I don't know. Is that so different from yes?

nodes.speaker: lou
nodes.text: Thank you. Weather is my one honest segment.

nodes.speaker: hank
nodes.text: Point is: who do we tell? Because we will need help, and help comes with a bill.
